title: Why You're Stuck at B1 (And the 3-Min Fix)
description:
Stuck at B1 or B2 English for years? You're not alone - 80% of intermediate learners stay intermediate forever. Not because they're lazy. Because they're doing 3 things that used to work and are now silently killing their fluency.

In this episode of FluentDrift, you'll learn the exact 3 mistakes keeping you stuck at the English fluency plateau - and the 22-minute daily routine that breaks it in 6 weeks.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
Why 'studying English' stops working after B1
The 500-chunk rule every fluent speaker uses (but no teacher teaches)
Why passive listening to podcasts doesn't improve your speaking
The 2-Minute Monologue drill that rewires your mouth
How '1-second shadowing' trains a native accent in 3 weeks
The Cambridge study that proves grammar is slowing you down

CHAPTERS

00:40 Why 80% of B1/B2 speakers stay stuck forever

05:30 The 1-second shadowing drill for a native accent
06:00 How Mei went from B1 to C1 in 42 days
06:30 The 22-minute daily plan
07:30 What to watch next

FluentDrift is for intermediate English learners (B1-B2) who understand grammar but freeze when they try to speak. If you've studied English for years and still can't have a natural conversation, this channel is built for you.
